The '''Belascoan Archive Report''' was a report on assaults backed by members of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] of [[Lexrul/Legends|Lexrul]], [[Drogheda/Legends|Drogheda]], [[Hathrox III|Hathrox]], [[Imram]] and [[Parcovey Minor]].
